name: Platinic-Palimpsest

civilization.name: Ysolde Dominion
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Dust finer than flour pools in the low places, swallowing craters to their rims. Nothing has disturbed an orbital debris ring in a million years, and the dust keeps its surface smooth as held breath.
Thin air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything.
Instruments disagree about the signal of unknown origin: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
Whoever solves this anomaly will rewrite several sciences. Whoever blunders into it will merely end several careers.
